2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:check-every-piece-is-covered and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads, through the person's records door, read only and in bounded pages, the ids of their Checks list and then its rows whose kind is piece (as tool:split-a-document-into-pieces keeps them, without their text), folding each page into a running tally, so a list of any size (40,000 rows and more) is read in one call.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: record:check (records:list).
